goal: The heavy independent Review turn budget grows with the number of changed paths instead of stopping at a flat 24 turns: a heavy Review gets 12 turns plus one per changed path, at least 24 and at most 48, so a wide change such as branch-boundary-r2 S4 serial-runner-retirement (29 paths, -12303 lines) is no longer cut off before the reviewer has read every changed file.

acceptance.assertion: The turn budget for a heavy Review is 12 plus the number of changed paths in its evidence, bounded below by 24 and above by 48: 12 or fewer paths give 24, 29 paths give 41, and 36 or more paths give 48, for both a review manifest (changed_paths) and a review bundle (dirty_files).

Quick and standard Reviews keep their flat 12 and 16 turn budgets regardless of path count, and the workload classification rules (critical, 9 or more acceptance items, 12 or more changed paths or more than 512 KiB of evidence for heavy; the routine quick limits) are unchanged.
The committed Claude MCP bundle matches the runtime source.
